Description (SPA): Identificador de casilla o acta dentro de un concurso electoral. No debe asumirse globalmente unico sin election_id.
Description (ENG): Polling-station or acta identifier within one election contest. It should not be assumed globally unique without election_id.
Notes: Composite primary key with election_id. For 2021 it is acta-level because CLAVE_ACTA is needed to avoid CLAVE_CASILLA duplicates.

Role: Composite primary key component; foreign key
Description (SPA): Identificador del concurso electoral al que pertenece la casilla o acta.
Description (ENG): Election-contest identifier to which the polling station or acta belongs.
Notes: Also part of the foreign-key path to fact_casilla_vote.

Description (SPA): Identificador geografico normalizado que ubica la casilla en entidad, seccion y distrito.
Description (ENG): Normalized geography identifier locating the polling station in state, section, and district.

Description (SPA): Clave numerica de entidad duplicada desde geografia para filtros rapidos y auditoria de carga.
Description (ENG): Numeric state key duplicated from geography for fast filters and load audit.
Notes: Redundant by design; do not treat differences from dim_geography as valid.

Description (SPA): Seccion electoral duplicada desde geografia para filtros rapidos y auditoria de carga.
Description (ENG): Electoral section duplicated from geography for fast filters and load audit.
Values / Domain: Integer; can be 0 for special foreign-vote rows in some cycles.
Notes: Redundant by design; use geo_id for normalized geography joins.

Description (SPA): Mejor identificador disponible de acta o casilla mecanizado para el ciclo. Sirve como puente de trazabilidad hacia la fuente limpia.
Description (ENG): Best available machine-readable acta or casilla identifier for the cycle. It provides traceability back to the clean source.
Notes: 1994/2000/2006/2015 map the synthesized casilla_id; 2021 maps CLAVE_ACTA. Later cycles can map ACTA_CASILLA-MEC.

Description (SPA): Tipo de casilla normalizado desde la fuente, por ejemplo basica, contigua, especial, extraordinaria o voto extranjero segun ciclo.
Description (ENG): Polling-station type normalized from the source, for example basic, contiguous, special, extraordinary, or foreign vote depending on cycle.
Values / Domain: Source-derived code/text such as B, C, E, S, P, Voto Extranjero.
Notes: Codes are not fully harmonized semantically across all historical files; use with cycle context.

Description (SPA): Numero consecutivo de casilla dentro del tipo, cuando puede parsearse de la fuente.
Description (ENG): Sequential polling-station number within type, when parseable from the source.
Notes: For basic casillas this is often 1; for contiguous casillas it identifies the contigua number.

Description (SPA): Extension de casilla contigua o componente adicional de identificacion cuando existe.
Description (ENG): Extra contiguous extension or additional identity component when present.
Notes: Often 0 in 2006/2015/2021; NULL where older sources do not expose the field.

Description (SPA): Lista nominal asociada a la casilla o acta cuando la fuente la reporta.
Description (ENG): Nominal voter list associated with the polling station or acta when reported by the source.
Notes: NULL for 1994 and 2000 additions; mapped from LISTA_NOMINAL_CASILLA or LISTA_NOMINAL in later files.

Description (SPA): Indicador o codigo de urna electronica cuando el ciclo lo incluye.
Description (ENG): Electronic ballot-box indicator/code when the cycle includes it.

Description (SPA): Estatus operativo del acta o casilla reportado por la fuente cuando existe y se conserva en el clean parquet.
Description (ENG): Operational acta or casilla status reported by the source when available and retained in clean parquet.
Notes: 2006 maps ESTATUS_ACTA. Other current additions usually load NULL even if an older raw status field existed but was not mapped to the warehouse.

Description (SPA): Ruta o referencia al archivo/imagen de acta cuando el ciclo la provee.
Description (ENG): Path or reference to the acta file/image when the cycle provides it.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
